modules/parentbilling — GET /traeger/care-cost-shares (#4687): the
Träger binding of the Träger transaction, the contract versions in force
(Betreuungsvertrag, one statement), the shares of the shown contracts with

and one insert of the read for every shown contract into the share trail.
